title: [Lean] Link an end-to-end proof of multiplication below n log n
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Add a pointer under “Research notes and verification contributions” to [Dan Brown](https://github.com/jdb19937) and [Kenny Daniel](https://github.com/platypii)'s end-to-end Lean proof of integer multiplication below n log n on Mathlib's finite Turing machines.

The fixed machine multiplies every input pair in worst-case time `O(n (log n)^(1−κ))` with **κ = 2^-93**. The explicit theorem also proves the exact saving `296 / (10^11 · 2^64)`, between `2^-93` and `2^-92`, using ε = `2^-30` and c = `2^-34`. These are asymptotic exponent bounds, not measured execution speedups.

Correctness and runtime are proved without remaining algorithmic or analytic assumptions. The theorem's transitive axiom dependencies remain exactly `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`.

## Task and overlap

Documentation pointer to an external completed proof, based on upstream `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`. This does not establish the selected conditional saving κ = `0.001672660197076918` or change the selected construction.

## Validation

The proof is pinned at [38ef57bb](https://github.com/platypii/integer-mult-bounds-lean/tree/38ef57bb8155b1c3f3a607b7b8e4ae5d1addd117): [statement and machine model](https://github.com/platypii/integer-mult-bounds-lean/blob/38ef57bb8155b1c3f3a607b7b8e4ae5d1addd117/IntegerMultBounds/MathlibTM2/Statement.lean), [explicit and existential theorems](https://github.com/platypii/integer-mult-bounds-lean/blob/38ef57bb8155b1c3f3a607b7b8e4ae5d1addd117/IntegerMultBounds/MathlibTM2/Theorem.lean), and [completed-proof axiom audit](https://github.com/platypii/integer-mult-bounds-lean/blob/38ef57bb8155b1c3f3a607b7b8e4ae5d1addd117/CompletedProofCheck.lean).

The pinned [PLAN.md](https://github.com/platypii/integer-mult-bounds-lean/blob/38ef57bb8155b1c3f3a607b7b8e4ae5d1addd117/PLAN.md) records passing local guarded theorem-only build and focused axiom audit for this theorem. Its [CI run](https://github.com/platypii/integer-mult-bounds-lean/actions/runs/38714339121) was cancelled; the [successor CI run](https://github.com/platypii/integer-mult-bounds-lean/actions/runs/38716587621) was still in progress when this description was updated.

Checked the README-only diff, whitespace, and stated rational bounds. No new Lean build or historical certificate replay was run for this documentation update.

## Credit

[Dan Brown](https://github.com/jdb19937) and [Kenny Daniel](https://github.com/platypii) are credited as the proof's coauthors. The external proof remains in its MIT-licensed repository; this PR contributes only the README pointer.

## Open next questions

Independent review of the linked theorem statement and machine/time model. The current binding cost is §6 transform-layout movement; direct CRT routing is the next implementation milestone and has not yet improved the public saving. Continue toward the selected conditional saving κ = `0.001672660197076918` while retaining the unconditional end-to-end machine proof and the same standard axiom dependencies.
